description: This file implements a cache resource class for Smarty that uses Memcache/Memcached to cache output. It provides methods for reading, writing, deleting, and purging cache entries, leveraging hash-based keys for compatibility with Memcache's key size limit.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Memcache
classes.description: A cache resource implementation for Smarty using Memcache or Memcached as backend storage, with key hashing to handle size limitations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache resource, selecting Memcache or Memcached implementation based on class existence, and adding a server at localhost:11211.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches values for a set of keys from the cache, returning an array of results with original keys.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in the cache with optional expiration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes specified keys from the cache.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.
